content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant barriers to monetizing their work. This guide focuses on using Supabase as the order database for your digital store, ensuring seamless crypto payments without relying on conventional platforms. With [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-18|Sovereign Commerce]]-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-21|coremerch]]'s infrastructure, you can deploy a fully operational store that grants you complete control and ownership over your data, enabling you to thrive in an increasingly restrictive landscape.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often exclude digital creators based on geographic restrictions or financial regulations. This infrastructure circumvents these limitations by leveraging open-source technologies and decentralized payment systems. By deploying on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you create a sovereign store that doesn't rely on third-party platforms. The combination of Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for crypto transactions ensures that you maintain complete ownership of your store's data while providing customers with a seamless purchasing experience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start your deployment, gather the core tools and accounts required for setup. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your store and a Supabase account for database management. Additionally, create a NOWPayments account to handle crypto payments efficiently. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, depending on your chosen stack. Ensure that your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, are ready for upload, and prepare any necessary marketing assets to promote your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring Supabase as your order database. Create tables to manage customer information and order details. Next, implement the NOWPayments integration to facilitate crypto transactions. This will involve setting up webhook notifications to trigger order confirmations upon successful payments. Ensure that you test the payment flow thoroughly to confirm that transactions are processed correctly. Once your payment pipeline is operational, organize your digital product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient delivery to customers once orders are placed.
Full ownership of your data is non-negotiable.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your store and ensuring that your payment pipeline is functioning, it’s time to go live. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that the public URL is accessible. Promote your store through social media or direct marketing to drive traffic. Monitor the first transactions to verify that payments are being processed accurately and that order confirmations are sent to customers. This is a critical step to ensure that your store runs smoothly and that customers have a positive experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your business. Analyze customer data in Supabase to understand buying patterns and preferences. This insight will inform your marketing strategies and product offerings. You can also expand your product range by adding new digital goods based on customer feedback. Regularly test your infrastructure to ensure it can handle increased traffic and transactions, and consider integrating additional tools or services for enhanced functionality as your business grows.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Decentralized payment systems offer freedom from platform restrictions.

This guide complements searches around hosting digital stores on GitHub Pages and using Cloudflare Pages with NOWPayments integration. If you need a more robust setup with additional features, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a comprehensive infrastructure solution for digital creators. You can explore products and deployment options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. Sign up for Supabase to manage your order database. Register for a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. Prepare your digital products for upload to your store. Set up webhook notifications in NOWPayments for order confirmations. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Promote your store to attract customers and drive sales.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for your order database, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. This setup is cost-effective and provides full control over your operations.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust solution. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours and includes additional features like SPF/DKIM configuration.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting your digital product store. They provide free hosting solutions that allow you to deploy your store with complete ownership and control.
What payment options can I integrate with my digital store?

You can integrate NOWPayments to process over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This allows you to accept payments without relying on traditional payment platforms, giving you greater sovereignty.
How long does it take to deploy a digital store using COREMERCH?
Deployment time varies by stack. Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 takes 48 hours and includes comprehensive testing before handoff.
